problem_statement:
Priority Support Card layout is different then others
I noticed that the "Priority support" card on the plans page has different layout (icon on the right, content on the left), then all the other cards (icon on the left, content on the right)
#### Steps to reproduce

1. On a site with a Premium or Business plan, go to: https://wordpress.com/plans/my-plan/{site}
2. Scroll down to the plan features.
3. Notice how the "Priority support" card has a different layout, then all the other cards on the page.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4550351/57667281-535e7b80-7646-11e9-817e-a7edd4535762.png)


#### What I expected
For the "Priority support" card to have the icon on the left, and content on the right, like all the other cards.

#dogfooding, #manual-testing
hints_text:
Working on it and wondering, if it would be acceptable to have the buttons stick out a little bit to the left (In all the other cards buttons are aligned with text)? Alternatively I could display the support doc link below the button.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4550351/58146232-8c2ad000-7c98-11e9-9e99-b0e0f37db73d.png)

Alternative:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4550351/58146384-2d198b00-7c99-11e9-8a3a-ddd53a80bd24.png)

Is it possible to use grid or flexbox to ensure that the Support link appears alongside the button when there's enough available width, and underneath when it's narrower?

I know this same block is used on the checkout Thank You page, for example, where it's displayed full width and there's enough space for the link to spread out.
Yes, I'm re-working this to use flexbox, so the link will appear next to the button at checkout.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4550351/58218094-087cec00-7d49-11e9-995c-f0d869f6fa20.png)

But on the plan page, the link and button will never be next to each other, since there's a max-width there, regardless of screen size.
